summary: Love may feel serious before it feels easy. You may protect your heart by expecting distance, delay, or proof.
body: Venus opposition Saturn describes restraint around love, pleasure, and receiving. You may be drawn to commitment, maturity, and loyalty, but also fear rejection or feel that affection must be earned through usefulness, patience, or self-control. This can create devotion and staying power, yet it can also make warmth feel conditional. The gift is love that honors time. The growth is allowing care to be present before a test has been passed.
gift: Loyalty, commitment, discernment, and the ability to build love slowly and responsibly.
shadow: Emotional withholding, fear of rejection, choosing unavailable people, and treating pleasure as unsafe.
integration: Let standards protect your heart without closing it. Reliability matters, but so does letting tenderness arrive in ordinary moments.
do: Choose people whose consistency is warm
